Asha: Need a final run-of-show + rehearsal plan for the May webinar. Keep it tactical.
Liam: Topic confirmed: resilient routing + graceful degradation. Need a killer demo and a clear buyer CTA.
Priya: Draft abstract: "Practical model routing: keep LLM features online during faults and scale events. Live failure-injection + playbook."
Noor: I can demo. Requirements: dev snapshot with KV caching, small quantized fallback, and a scripted region failover. Need ~25m live.
Diego: Schedule: full dress 24h before (45m), greenroom 15m before, and a 10m pre-recorded fallback clip.
Raj: For slides, include p95 latency plots and token-cost per-path comparison.
Carlos: We should add a 1-page cheat sheet (migration checklist) as gated CTA.
eng-runtime: We can spin a test pool for 6h. Ping config.
Sam (ops-bot): Invite created: "Webinar: Practical Model Routing" Thu May 28 10:00 PDT.
Asha: Owners: Liam=copy+LP, Priya=prompts+metrics, Noor=demo+video, Diego=logistics. Post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
